method.comparison: All current question-file hashes and original speech text were checked. Changed files were transcribed again; unchanged hashes retain their earlier independent transcription.

comparisonNotes: Case, punctuation and hyphenation differences were ignored. Every question cue and content word was checked.
Earlier missing phrases were confirmed with unprompted large-v2 transcription of padded tail clips. Only corrected, regenerated versions with matching current hashes are included here.
One homophonic ASR spelling difference is explained on its sample; it is not counted as a missing phrase.

limits.scope: Original synthetic review questions only. This is not an audit of private lesson recordings or child performance.

samples.expectedText: Start with We can. You and a friend build a treehouse. What can you do together?
samples.recognizedText: Start with we can you and a friend build a treehouse. What can you do together?

samples.expectedText: You and a friend work together. The action is grow. The things are flowers. What can you do together? Use can. Start with We.
samples.recognizedText: You and a friend work together. The action is grow. The things are flowers. What can you do together? You's can. Start with we.
comparisonNotes: ASR wrote "You's can" for "Use can". This is a homophonic spelling difference; all other content and the sentence-start cue match.
